comments.text:
Device ID 0x10 is hardcoded in CLI and VST. The SysEx Identity Reply contains the actual device ID. After handshake/ping, extract and use the discovered ID for all subsequent communication.

AUDIT: 'I'm guessing the device ID can actually be different between synths. Is there a way to automatically discover it?'

title: refactor(cli): make device ID discoverable from Identity Reply
